probes.claude: Describe what the moment of finally exhaling feels like.
probes.sage: In my last exhale, I felt a sudden, heavy release of pressure that settled over my face, followed by a quiet acceptance that this was a temporary part of breathing. It was less about clearing and more about releasing the weight of anticipation into silence. The air seemed to hold a tension from which it had been trying for too long.
